title: Teodoro on VP Duterte’s remarks: No compromise in defending rights in WPS

blocks.text: Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Wednesday said the Philippines should not back down from defending its rights in the West Philippine Sea despite China’s greater military strength, describing the choice between standing up for the country’s rights and giving in as a “false choice.”
